answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 5928 Country: India Title: Rain water on running on roads, paak/na-paak? Question: Rain water on running on roads, paak/na-paak? Answer ID: 5928 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 637/595=L/1429) It is tahir (pure), yes if it is mixed with the water of drains and its clour, smell and taste changes then it will be regarded as najis (impure). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
